description.narrative: Strategies in the Court of Cassation for “disseminating code of ethics”, “strengthening transparency” and “increasing trust in the judiciary” in line with universal values, good practices and lessons learned in other countries.

condition.narrative: Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).
UNDP as the Implementing Partner will comply with the policies, procedures and practices of the United Nations Security Management System (UNSMS.)

description.narrative: - Establishment of and Ethics Advisory Boar and a Personnel Ethics Committee within CoC by 2017 - Number of news items referring to the efforts of the CoC on enhancing ethics - Increase in the number of references to the code of judicial conduct for CoC in international and national policy documents - 20% of the measures in the Transparency strategy implemented by 2018 - At least 20 more high courts recognize the Istanbul Principles on Transparency in Judicial Process by end of 2018 - Smooth relationships between CoC, relevant institutions and citizens creating and environment free from bias - Establishment of a public relations unit within the CoC in line with principles of transparency

comment.narrative: - Code of Ethics for CoC personnel, judges, members and prosecutors drafted in 2013 - Assessment of CoC on the needs for enhancing transparency in the judiciary undertaken in 2014 - No baseline specifically on public awareness regarding the CoC's work
